# Degraded compilation when LLM is unavailable or explicitly disabled

The compilation pipeline supports a degraded mode: when no LLM is used or the provider fails, compilation continues without failing and previously extracted LLM entities are preserved. Degraded runs are recorded (CompileRun.degraded == True) and warnings indicate degradation.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_llm_layer.py` — `tests.test_llm_layer.test_no_llm_flag_degrades_and_preserves_semantic_entities`
